settings.label: Zombie health (x)
settings.description: 125 at 1; headshots do three times the damage.

settings.label: Blow strength
settings.description: 60: a blow takes 15-30 health before armour.

settings.label: Speed (x)
settings.description: Movement and animation together, so feet stay planted.

settings.label: Hunting pace (m/s)
settings.description: Once one is after you. You walk at 2.5 and sprint at 5; wanderers drift at about 0.45, enraged ones sprint at 1.6 times this (Speed above 1 is held to what their run can keep up with).

settings.label: Chance a shot enrages it
settings.description: Enraged, a zombie charges you for 6-12 s. Otherwise they shamble.

settings.label: Hearing (x)
settings.description: At 1, gunshots carry 140 m, running 40 m, walking 15 m, crouching 6 m.

settings.label: They lose you after (s out of sight)
settings.description: How long a zombie keeps after you once its line of sight to you is broken. Every glimpse of you starts the count again.

settings.label: Bodies with loot (share)
settings.description: A few rounds or something to eat.

settings.label: The dead are replaced
settings.description: Each killed zombie is replaced in the area 30-90 s later.

settings.label: Swarm pressure (x)
settings.description: While you are seen or heard, more come, faster and closer. Hide out of sight to let it cool. 0 = off.
